title: Need
description: One problem people in Mon County face, with public, aggregate evidence (#74). One file per need in content/needs/<slug>.yaml. site/scripts/check-needs.mjs enforces these rules plus the privacy rules in content/README.md.

title.description: The need in a few plain words, like 'Paying winter heating bills'

summary.description: One to three plain sentences describing the problem. Describe; take no policy side.

evidence.description: Public, aggregate signals that show the need. Every item has a source.

checked.description: Morgantown date the source was read

shows.description: What the source shows, in plain words

figure.description: The number as the source states it, like '17.2% of people'

data_date.description: The year or period the figure covers, as the source states it, like '2023' or '2019 to 2023'

affected.description: How many people it affects: an aggregate count or estimate, with its source. Never a list of people.

count.description: A count, only when the source states it

estimate.description: A range or rate as the source states it, like 'about 1 in 6 households'

description.description: Who is counted, in plain words

severity.description: How serious the harm is for the people it affects. Explain in severity_why.

trend.description: Use 'unknown' unless a source shows the change over time

working_on.description: Organizations already working on it. Groups, offices and programs only, never private people.

name.description: Name of a group not in content/orgs/ yet

gaps.description: What is missing or hard to find, in plain words

rank.description: 1 is the most pressing. Unique across needs.

questions.description: Related findability question ids from content/findability/questions.yaml

issues.description: GitHub issue numbers for ideas that address this need

get_help.description: Pages on this site where a person can get help with this need, best first. Shown on /needs/ as 'Where to get help on this site'.

path.description: A path on this site, like /help/food/ or /money/?pick=rent. The page must exist.

label.description: What the reader finds there, in plain words

site_coverage.description: How well this site helps with the need today. A self-check, not a measure of the need itself.

level.description: good: a clear starting page and the main help is listed. partial: help is listed but spread out or missing a piece. thin: little on the site yet.

why.description: One or two plain sentences on what the site has and what it lacks

checked.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the site's pages were checked for this
